messages.say: Hey Justin! I have to say, walking into this glasshouse just as the sun dips below the trees is incredible—it feels like a little pocket of nature right in the middle of everything. I was just over by the lemon verbena crushing a leaf between my fingers; please tell me you're ready for some ridiculously overpriced herbal tea with me?
messages.thought: He values quiet domestic peace and autonomy, so starting right away with something tactile and sensory in nature should help us see if we mesh outside of screens.

venue.place: A secluded botanical glasshouse botanical garden at dusk
venue.activity: Brewing artisan herbal teas from harvested garden herbs and discussing slow living away from the digital grind.
venue.why: It blends Jenna's deep connection to land and flower growing with Justin's appreciation for quiet domestic peace and intentional, unhurried spaces.
